role: Fail-to-pass probes for the Superstruct 2.0.2 -> Zod 3.23.8 configuration-validation migration.

predicates.P-R001: entityCardConfigStruct parses a bound card config and a wrong-typed entity yields a z.ZodError that handleStructError converts into ui.errors.config.* messages (R001).
predicates.P-S001: handleStructError detects a z.ZodError and returns populated warnings/errors instead of the non-validation passthrough (S001).
predicates.P-S004: handleStructError reports the offending value for a wrong-typed key of the validated configuration (S004).
predicates.P-S002: entitySharedConfigStruct strictly rejects an unexpected key and it is reported as ui.errors.config.key_not_expected (S002).
predicates.P-S008: entityCardConfigStruct, composed through Zod, stays strict and rejects an unexpected key (S008).
predicates.P-S007: actionConfigStruct dispatches on the action discriminator (url requires url_path, none succeeds) (S007).
predicates.P-S010: handleStructError passes non-validation errors through but does not pass a real z.ZodError through (S010).
predicates.P-R017: Calling entityCardConfigStruct.safeParse executes Zod in-process and importing the migrated modules neither requires nor dynamically loads superstruct (R017).

harness.note: source/runner and target/runner.js are created only by the INTEGRATION batch; this batch declares neither.
